source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 310 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 310 was established by Ordinance No. 20304, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 10, 1989. Ordinance No. 20304 amended Ordinance Nos. 10962 and 19455, Chapters 51 and 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19455; 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.102. PROPERTY LOCATION.

PD 310 is established on property generally located at the northwest corner of Zang Boulevard and Madison Avenue. The size of PD 310 is approximately 0.86 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, all references to code articles, divisions, or sections in this article refer to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations contained in Chapter 51A apply to this article. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Development of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 310A). (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.105. LANDSCAPING.

If development of the Property is expanded, landscaping must be provided for that expansion in accordance with Article X, “Landscape Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.106. USES.

The following uses are permitted on the Property:

(1) Inside industrial manufacturing, limited to the manufacture of candy, ice cream, and ice cream additives. A warehouse use is expressly permitted as an accessory use subject to the general provisions in Section 51-4.217.

(2) Any use permitted in the CR Community Retail District. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Floor Area
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.107. MAXIMUM FLOOR AREA.

Floor area on the Property is limited to 11,600 square feet. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.108. SETBACKS.

Setbacks required for all structures on the Property are those setbacks provided by the existing building, as shown on the development plan. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.109. MAXIMUM LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum lot coverage on the Property is 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Height And Stories
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.110. MAXIMUM HEIGHT AND STORIES.

Maximum height for any structure on the Property is 54 feet and maximum number of stories is four. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.111. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking must be provided in accordance with the requirements of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.112. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

(a) Use of the Property must comply with the requirements of all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(b) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(c) The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-310.114. ZONING MAP.

PD 310 is located on Zoning Map No. K-7. (Ord. Nos. 20304; 25850)
